question: Which of the following viruses can easily cause a latent infection ?:
analysis: Cytomegalovirus (CMV) is known for its ability to establish latent infections in the host. It can remain dormant in the body and reactivate later, especially in immunocompromised individuals. Parotitis (mumps) and Hepatitis A do not typically cause latent infections, while 'Rage' is not a recognized virus in this context.
